basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old language enthusiast from Wellington, New Zealand. Currently working as a software developer, I spend my free time diving into language learning and exploring various cultures. I have a particular interest in French and Russian, as I'm planning a trip to Europe next year. I'm usually online during the late evenings and weekends. I'm single and enjoy participating in online communities to share and gain knowledge on languages, cars, and technology.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in computer science and a minor in linguistics. I've always been passionate about languages, which led me to self-study French and Russian. My love for cars stems from my teenage years, where I often helped my father in his garage. I keep up with the latest tech trends through online courses and forums.
